Job Title: Data Engineer (Remote)

Duration: 6-12 Months with possible extension

***Due to client requirements this role is only open to USC or GC candidates***

Job Summary:
Data Engineer (Python, AWS, SQL, Snowflake, Databricks)

Tech Stack: Data Engineering skillset


5+ years experience in application development using Python and SQL
5+ years experience with public cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure
5+ years experience with distributed data/computing tools (MapReduce, Hadoop, EMR, Kafka, Spark).
5+ years experience working with real-time data and streaming applications.
5+ years experience with data warehouses and services (Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift)
5+ years experience with data modeling for data warehousing
Experience leveraging interactive AI tooling (Claude Code, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate software delivery
